text:
taylor: quick note  saw a blip in embeddings p95 during a synthetic test. suspect dimensionality churn + our current practice of emitting raw dim as a label. dash: https://dash.redwood.ai/q/embeds-dim-blip :thinking_face:

metrics-bot: ALERT: embeddings.p95 > 500ms (4m)  affected tenants: 12 (hot: partner-z)

omar: raw-dim tags are killing our Prometheus series. we need a bounded label space immediately. propose short-term fix: map dims -> `d64|d128|d256|d512|d1024|d2k+` at ingress

lex: +1. addendum: make sampling tenant-consistent (hash tenant_id + sampling_ver) so if a tenant surfaces a regression we keep seeing their samples instead of random noise

taylor: where to compute mapping? ingress has the header `x-rwd-embed-dim-hint` if SDKs send it. if missing, do a lightweight sniff (peek array length in the request) but mark `client_hint=sniffed`

zara: telemetry impact: current unique-series/day ~600k. bucket+sampling target ~22k/day. ops estimate ~75% series reduction. also want a tiny debug stream with raw numeric dims for 0.05% of events for calibration

omar: quota/billing note: counters used for quota must not be sampled. always emit `embed.units` counters. only traces/histograms/verbose spans are sampled down

lex: alerting: create per-bucket rolling baselines (14d) and only enable new per-bucket alerts after baseline backfill. for canary, mute alerts and monitor dashboards manually for 72h

taylor: rollout plan: feature flag `embeds.dim_buckets_v1`. canary group = 8% of tenants (low volume) for 48h -> 40% for 48h -> full. owners: taylor (docs + SDK), omar (ingress + sampling), lex (dashboards/alerts), zara (cost estimate)

metrics-bot: NOTE: dashboards querying `by(dimension)` will break. update queries to `by(dim_bucket)`; keep a legend mapping table in Grafana to decode buckets

omar: quick pseudo for ingress: `bucket = map_dim(hint || sniff(payload)) ; emit_counter("embed.requests", {tenant, dim_bucket: bucket}); if sample_decision(tenant, bucket) emit_histogram(lat_ms, {dim_bucket: bucket, trace})`

zara: please limit `client_hint` to three values: `sdk_hint|preflight_none|sniffed`. also add `sampling_ver` label to allow rollbacks without mixing series

lex: i'll prepare dashboard PR and sequence diagram. taylor will draft a 1-pager. schedule aim: RFC by tomorrow, canary next Tue. any objections?

taylor: no objections. thanks team :thumbsup:
